people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Micah
people.line: A man from Ephraim who set up idolatrous worship.

translations.web: When they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men who were in the houses near Micah’s house gathered together and overtook the children of Dan.
translations.bsb: After they were some distance from Micah’s house, the men in the houses near Micah’s house mobilized and overtook the Danites.
translations.kjv: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that were in the houses near to Micah's house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.
translations.asv: When they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that were in the houses near to Micah's house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.
